WPMS No.3762 of 2025
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Gyan Mati Kushwaha, Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Devendra Pant, S.C. for the State.
3. This writ petition has been filed under Article 227 of 
the Constitution of India, whereby the petitioner has sought 
a direction to respondent no.2–District Magistrate, Udham 
Singh Nagar to decide the application dated 18.10.2023 for 
transfer of license of firearm and ammunition in his own 
name filed under Section 25 of the Arms Rules 2016 r/w 
Arms Act, 1959, expeditiously.
4. Learned counsel for the State prays for and is granted 
four weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
5. List this case on 23.02.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
